model.frequency: Daily after-close predictions, earliest execution next open
model.encoder: Shared stock GRU, stock -> dated multi-label concept -> stock mean aggregation
model.router: Learned softmax of own temporal, graph and market-mean embeddings; optional weak causal-stage supervision
model.label_purge: Every horizon label_end_date strictly before fit_cutoff; training labels additionally strictly before the first validation signal
model.validation: Last 20 available pre-cutoff sessions by default; train-only scaler; early stopping and optional native-unit calibration
model.score: Expected simple return minus explicit nonnegative downside risk penalty, NOT historical momentum or a ranking-score alias

features.calendar: Complete market sessions; never bridge missing stock quotes
features.adjustment: Actual daily adj_factor; no future month-end interpolation
features.stage_labels: Past-only weak context: breakout, reversal, continuation, range
features.universe: All supplied SH/SZ boards including ChiNext and STAR; buy restriction is execution-only
features.scaling: Fixed clipping bounds here; train-only standardization in model

graph_update: Dated snapshot schedule, not a newly observed daily graph
checkpoint_fits: Quarterly, strictly purged before fit; daily inference and next-open execution
evaluation_status: 2026 is previously inspected research history, not a new untouched test set
